newsitem.title: INDIA: India lawmakers approve budget extension.
newsitem.headline: India lawmakers approve budget extension.

text.p: The lower house of India's parliament passed a bill providing for the continued appropriation of money to fund government programmes until the 1997/98 (April-March) budget is approved.
The measure, called a vote on account, is considered a formality and permits the continuation of programmes through July or until the budget for 1997/98 is adopted by parliament.
Parliament is scheduled to begin a month-long recess on Friday and to vote on the tax and spending bill in late April or early May.
